text.name: input_FLOWDRIVE_FLOW
text.text: FlowDrive: automatic crop flow on / off (harvesters)

text.name: input_FLOWDRIVE_INCHING
text.text: FlowDrive: inching (hold: slow down, keep engine speed)

text.name: fd_opt_enabled_tt
text.text: Off: base game driving for this vehicle.

text.name: fd_opt_ramp_tt
text.text: Auto: 2 at work or heavily loaded, 3 when empty, 4 on loaders. 1: gentle, 4: lively. Also sets engine braking when you release the pedal.

text.name: fd_opt_range_tt
text.text: Auto: road range; on a harvester, harvest range as soon as the machine is running.

text.name: fd_opt_ptoEco_tt
text.text: Same PTO speed with about 22 % less engine speed (540E / 1000E).

text.name: fd_opt_memory_tt
text.text: Hand throttle: the engine holds this speed, ground speed is set with cruise control.

text.name: fd_opt_boostMode_tt
text.text: Compare this power with the real spec sheet. Included: it is already the boosted power, FlowDrive lowers it outside boost. Added: it is the power without boost, the boost comes on top.

text.name: fd_opt_boost_tt
text.text: Above 16 km/h with no lowered implement, and with the PTO. Use the “Boost: enter %” button to change the value (real tractors: 5 to 20 %).

text.name: fd_opt_flow_tt
text.text: Speed drops when engine load exceeds 90 %, then rises below 75 % up to the cruise speed.

text.name: fd_opt_hydraulic_tt
text.text: Engine speed rises when a cylinder moves (loader, boom, tipper) or when a self-propelled machine is running.

text.name: fd_opt_preheat_tt
text.text: Below 5 °C, preheating for 2 to 15 s before starting.

text.name: fd_opt_cold_tt
text.text: Cold engine: engine speed limited to 72 % and ramp 2 maximum (ADS threshold when installed).

text.name: fd_opt_serverRule_tt
text.text: Multiplayer: this setting follows the game host's setting.

text.name: fd_opt_hud_tt
text.text: Small display: ramp, range and transmission state.

text.name: fd_opt_hudPos_tt
text.text: Right: above the speedometer. Left: above the map.

text.name: fd_opt_dbl_tt
text.text: Provides ramp, range and lamps to screens that used to read CVT Addon.

text.name: fd_reason_electric
text.text: electric motor, left to the game

text.name: fd_msg_notAvailable
text.text: FlowDrive: not available on this vehicle (%s)

text.name: fd_msg_rangeRefused
text.text: FlowDrive: slow down below %d km/h to change range

text.name: fd_msg_memNeed
text.text: FlowDrive: activate an engine speed memory first

text.name: fd_msg_boostOn
text.text: FlowDrive: boost %d %% (%s), on the road and with the PTO

text.name: fd_msg_boostInvalid
text.text: FlowDrive: boost refused, enter a number from 0 to %d

text.name: fd_msg_flowOnlyHarvester
text.text: FlowDrive: automatic crop flow is for harvesters only

text.name: fd_msg_flowOn
text.text: FlowDrive: automatic crop flow (speed follows engine load)

text.name: fd_msg_preheatDone
text.text: FlowDrive: preheating done, you can start

text.name: fd_msg_cold
text.text: FlowDrive: cold engine (%d °C), engine speed limited to %d rpm until %d °C

text.name: fd_msg_coldTestRunning
text.text: FlowDrive: cold test (-15 °C). Stop the engine, then start again for preheating

text.name: fd_msg_coldTestOn
text.text: FlowDrive: cold test (-15 °C). Start the engine
